[[Category:Philosophy]]
'''Historical review''' is a method to study [[philosophy]], consisting of reviewing historical treatments of a topic.

== Justification ==

Fundamental questions on morality and social organisation, such as the definition of "a good life", are of omnitemporal importance. Inspirations for contemporarily-relevant answers to those fundamental questions can often be drawn from arguments made by philosophers in other historical periods.<ref>{{#cite:Q1837}}</ref>
